activity_summary: At twenty past two you said Thomas had the king, and that you were in a cap. You said the custard was good. You did not say how the afternoon was going, because you did not know.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the two sentences and did not add a result.

entities.name: the custard
entities.context: Mentioned in The custard was good

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Two of the clock, and Thomas has it.
